name: List available Page Rules settings
description: List available Page Rules settings Returns a list of settings (and their details) that Page Rules can apply to matching requests. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/settings
Returns a list of settings (and their details) that Page Rules can apply to matching requests.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Create a Page Rule
description: Create a Page Rule Creates a new Page Rule. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules
Creates a new Page Rule.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Page Rule
description: Delete a Page Rule Deletes an existing Page Rule. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/{pagerule_id}

name: Edit a Page Rule
description: Edit a Page Rule Updates one or more fields of an existing Page Rule. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/{pagerule_id}

name: Get a Page Rule
description: Get a Page Rule Fetches the details of a Page Rule. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/{pagerule_id}

name: List Page Rules
description: List Page Rules Fetches Page Rules in a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules
Fetches Page Rules in a zone.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: order (query); direction (query); match (query); status (query)

name: Update a Page Rule
description: Update a Page Rule Replaces the configuration of an existing Page Rule. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules/{pagerule_id}
